test_backend_ops_htp0: test the backend_ops_htp0 function to run test-backend-ops on HTP0 backend with mxfp4, fp16, or q4_0 type_a
run_test_backend_ops_posix: run the test-backend-ops posix script via pytest to execute on-device HTP0 backend tests
install_backend_ops_bundle: install the test-backend-ops bundle to the device before running backend operations tests
run_adb_test_command: run the test-backend-ops adb command with GGML_HEXAGON environment variables on the HTP0 backend
write_qdc_test_log: write the test-backend-ops stdout output to a qdc log file for test result tracking
